meta: SEO for wedding businesses: rank your venue, studio or planning service higher on Google and turn couple searches into booked weddings. Free audit.
subhead: Venues, planners, photographers, florists, DJs and every vendor in between. I rank wedding businesses higher on Google so couples find you first.
intro: The wedding industry runs on searches now. Couples book the venue, planner, photographer and every vendor through Google, in a sequence, months before the wedding. This page covers SEO for all nine wedding vendor types.

faqs.q: How long does SEO take for a wedding business?
faqs.a: Usually three to six months before enquiries flow steadily, because wedding keywords are competitive in big cities. Profile and review fixes can move the map pack within weeks. Timing matters too: starting in autumn means you are ranking when the December to March booking wave hits.

faqs.q: I already get bookings from Instagram. Why do I need Google?
faqs.a: Instagram is rented attention. An algorithm change can halve your reach overnight, and most scrolling is browsing, not buying. Google catches couples at the moment they are ready to hire, typing the exact service and city. The fullest calendars I see always have both channels working.

faqs.q: Should I show my prices on my website?
faqs.a: At least honest ranges. Cost searches are some of the closest-to-booking searches in the wedding industry, and a pricing page ranks for them while competitors hide behind contact forms. Ranges also pre-qualify enquiries, so you stop hearing from couples with a tenth of your minimum.

faqs.q: Do I need a separate page for each service I offer?
faqs.a: For every service couples search by name, yes. A barn venue page, a 360 booth page, a documentary photography page: each targets its own search with its own buyers. One generic services page trying to rank for all of them ranks for none.

faqs.q: How much do reviews really matter?
faqs.a: Enormously. Reviews decide map pack rankings and they close the sale for couples comparing vendors late at night. Ask at the emotional peak: the week the gallery is delivered, the day after the event. A steady flow of specific, recent reviews beats a perfect score from three years ago.

faqs.q: Can one website rank for both weddings and corporate work?
faqs.a: Yes, with clearly separated sections. Corporate planners and engaged couples search differently and buy differently, so each gets its own pages and its own calls to action. What you must not do is mix them: a corporate buyer landing on wedding confetti photos bounces.

faqs.q: What does working with you actually involve?
faqs.a: It starts with a free audit where I look at your site, your Google profile and your competitors, live on a call. Then we fix in priority order: profile and reviews first, money pages second, then the content and vendor links that compound. You approve everything before it goes live.
